thumbnail|Germinated [[cannabis seeds.]]
Germination is the process of seeds growing into new plants.

Germination rate

Germination rate is the number of germinated seeds to the number of seeds that were planted. It's usually expressed as a percentage. For example, if you planted 100 cannabis seeds and 80 seeds germinated, the germination rate is 80%.
